endorsements.quote: We recommend that researchers, implementers, and strategic decision makers consider the use of existing theory-informed HIT evaluation frameworks before embarking on an AI-related initiative.

unlisted_practices: Integrate theory-informed health IT evaluation frameworks into existing and emerging guidelines for the evaluation of AI.
Involve end users actively and iteratively in the design and development of AI systems.
Base evaluation of AI-based systems on theoretically informed empirical studies in real implementation or use contexts.

screen.reason: This is a conceptual viewpoint/framework paper recommending the adoption of existing health IT evaluation frameworks to safely guide the development and implementation of AI in clinical settings.
